Amit Shah envisions India as global sports hub

Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated on Friday that India aims to become a major global center for all sports-related activities. This includes hosting international events like the Olympics, developing into a hub for sports training and coaching for both Indian and international athletes, and potentially manufacturing sports equipment. Shah made these remarks during the inauguration of the World Archery Para Series 2026, which is being held in India and features participation from 19 nations. He emphasized that India's sporting vision extends beyond just winning medals.
